citation.title: Heating of toroidal plasmas by neutral injection

topic: Neutral-beam ion-source scaling, beam neutralization and ionization, fast-ion orbits and thermalization, and analytic heating estimates for the planned ATC tokamak.
own_question: Is fast-neutral injection a competitive heating method for experimental and reactor-scale tokamaks?
actual_method_and_evidence: Analytic scaling and model calculations using cross sections, the Sivukhin slowing-down equation and guiding-center orbits. It presents a design study for ATC, a device then under construction. The extracted text contains no CES, BES or ECEI data and no measurements, forecasting or validation.
input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not relevant. The paper has no diagnostic inputs, CES reports or timing analysis.
validation_if_relevant: None. The ATC injection numbers are predictions, not measurements.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite this paper as background on CES, charge-exchange spectroscopy or impurity Ti measurement. Its charge-exchange discussion covers beam neutralization and ionization only.
Do not treat the ATC heating estimates as achieved performance.
Do not link the paper to nowcasting, KSTAR or BES/ECEI.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Exclude. The paper is historical NBI heating physics. At most it could serve as a generic beam-physics reference if CES beam-based charge exchange is mentioned, and the focused intro does not need that.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
